description: This source file implements platform-specific file utility functions for the quiche project, including path joining, file reading, and directory enumeration for different operating systems.

classes.name: ScopedDir
classes.description: RAII wrapper for directory handles, managing resource cleanup for platform-specific directory iteration.

methods.name: JoinPathImpl
methods.description: Concatenates two path segments with appropriate separator based on platform.

methods.name: ReadFileContentsImpl
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string, platform-specific implementation.

methods.description: Enumerates files and directories within a given path, platform-specific implementation.
